er01_return_erased_implicit.reason: Deliberate, sound Cure restriction (founding spec §8): Cure erases ALL implicit {..} parameters unconditionally ({0,omega}), so returning the erased implicit k at a runtime Nat result is ill-formed and the M8.3 relevance check rejects it. Idris instead infers implicit multiplicity and keeps runtime-used implicits at omega, so `rel x = k` type-checks there. The divergence is the erasure discipline, not soundness — the sound Cure phrasing makes k an explicit (present) parameter.

er02_forget_erased_index_sigma.reason: Deliberate, sound Cure restriction. `%[d, sf]` materialises the erased index d into the runtime-relevant FIRST component of a Sigma (Cure keeps both Sigma components at runtime, Erase.erase). Under Cure's erase-all-implicits discipline d has no runtime representation, so the M8.3 check rejects the pack. Idris keeps the implicit d at omega and accepts. Sound Cure phrasing: make d an explicit (present) parameter so it is genuinely available to pack.
